issue.title: zig build test-integration: continuation of ISS-0665 — 300s BPM_TEST_STMT_TIMEOUT default insufficient under full concurrency on this host
issue.task: WF-03 Issue Resolving for GH-752 / ISS-0692: zig build test-integration (against a freshly-verified-healthy BPM_TEST_DB_URL, per zig build test-env-verify reporting HEALTHY 10/10 immediately before each run) is non-deterministic and fails differently across consecutive clean runs on the SAME commit (origin/main 2c7046e1). Most failures are runMigrations / runMigrationsForSchema failing with PgError.ServerError while acquiring pg_advisory_lock(hashtext('bpm_test_migrations_public')) in tests/integration/helpers.zig, plus several 'test runner failed to respond for ~1m<N>ms' entries, plus genuine non-contention failures (one example: tests/integration/sim01_04_simulation_mode_test.zig TC-SIM-01-01 DebugAllocator leak, filed as GH-753/ISS-0691, handled in a sibling WF-03 run). After each run, zig build test-env-verify reports ungranted advisory locks left behind. This is a CONTINUATION of ISS-0665 (RESOLVED 2026-08-12, #702): ISS-0665's fix widened DDL statement_timeout to BPM_TEST_STMT_TIMEOUT (default 300s) bracketed around the migration DDL window in tests/integration/helpers.zig runMigrations() and runMigrationsForSchema(); the fix is present in the current main tree (lines 132-145, 210-223). Despite that fix, statement-timeout cancellations still occur at ~65s intervals during failure runs (verified via docker logs r-co-db_test-1). Concurrency gradient observed on this host: 52 failures (full default concurrency) → 2 failures (-j4) → 2 failures (-j4-repeat), consistent with host-capacity contention, NOT with a deterministic code regression. Candidate mitigations to investigate (do not pre-commit to a specific one — diagnose first): (a) raise the default BPM_TEST_STMT_TIMEOUT further (e.g. 600s or 900s) in the blk fall-through in tests/integration/helpers.zig lines ~139 and ~217; (b) add a default -j cap to the test-integration build step in build.zig (e.g. -j8 or -j6) so Zig does not schedule ~40 binaries simultaneously on this host; (c) investigate whether the 'ungranted locks after each run' symptom is a SEPARATE defect (lock not released on the cancellation path) that should be fixed independently. Run the full WF-03 pipeline. This is BLOCKER severity — PRM-02/PRM-03/PRM-04/PRM-05 WF-02 implementation cannot proceed until test-integration is reliably green on main (per docs/guides/test_infrastructure_guide.md §4).
